basis: Live long-run evidence plus controlled same-canonical rolling wake tests support completion-relative continuation with a longer provisional rescue horizon.
fallback_guarantee_target: If the active invocation disappears, the already-verified provisional future occurrence provides bounded cold rescue; normal successful closes move the next occurrence to a short completion-relative delay.

independent_fast_wake_upgrade.producer: GitHub PR event lane; optional guarded Actions stale-owner producer

measurement.live_run_useful_span: May exceed 900 seconds; keep measuring continuous evidence rather than forcing artificial turn closure.
measurement.recovery_gap: Measure from last meaningful predecessor progress to first meaningful replacement-worker progress.
measurement.product_slo: Optimize union of evidenced useful-work intervals, normal continuation gap, and abrupt-loss recovery latency independently.
